programme.title: Snakes In The City
programme.desc: Cobra in the Kitchen: Snake catchers Simon and Siouxsie go to the rescue when the weather draws venomous snakes into homes and offices. Among them is a deadly black mamba. (S3, ep 1) 7+

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Savannah Survivors: From highspeed cheetah hunts in the Karoo to deadly river crossings in the Serengeti, watch as Africa's savannah residents fight to survive. 7+ (S8, ep 2)

programme.title: Zoo: Disney's Animal Kingdom
programme.desc: Giant Leap For Rhinokind: A critically endangered antelope needs urgent care, a baby rhino takes her first steps out on the savannah and a beloved manatee visits the dentist. 7+ (S2 9/10)

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: All in the Farm-Ily: Leading up to the big Schroeder family dinner, Dr Ben and Dr Erin are challenged by some rare animal cases. (S2, ep 6)

programme.title: Wild Bhutan: The Last Shangri-La
programme.desc: ...The Last Shangri-La. Explore this Eden between Tibet and India, a place where nature and religion have combined to turn a tiny Buddhist kingdom into the world's last Shangri-La. 7+

programme.title: Wild Florida
programme.desc: Gator Country: A look at Florida's spectacular wildlife and deadly predators, including the harsh odds of survival facing a set of new-born alligator hatchlings. 7+

programme.title: Investigation Shark Attack
programme.desc: California Great Whites: Encounters with great white sharks are rising in California, and the team investigates why. Drone footage provides a window into shark behaviour. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Britain's Greatest Machines...
programme.desc: ...with Chris Barrie: 1980s: Chris Barrie takes a ride in a Back to the Future DeLorean DMC and revisits the battles of the Falklands War as he seeks out the greatest British machines. 7+

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: No Horsing Around: Dental damage is no trouble for an old horse with a history of being a survivor, but another pony's mysterious nosebleed needs a deeper look. (S7, ep 3) 7+

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: North Carolina
programme.desc: Puffin but Trouble: As keepers dream of a sand cat kitten, a nervous puffin chick learns to swim and rescued black bear cubs prepare for life outside the zoo. (S1, ep 8) 7+

programme.title: Fish My City
programme.desc: Fastest Fish in Miami: In Magic City, Mike faces the tough task of catching the fastest fish in the world. He also hunts for three exotic species that are a long way from home. (S1 ep 4) 7+

programme.title: Fish My City

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
